execution.raw_text: {"up": "Select assay_chembl_id, target_type, tax_id, canonical_smiles, molecule_chembl_id, standard_type, pchembl_value from activities joined to assays on assay_id, assays joined to target_dictionary on tid, activities joined to molecule_dictionary on molregno, molecule_dictionary joined to compound_structures on molregno. Filter to target_dictionary.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1954', activities.standard_type = 'IC50', activities.standard_relation = '=', activities.pchembl_value IS NOT NULL.
